# Syncareer

> An opportunity-first career workspace for African students and recent graduates. Save real opportunities, connect their requirements to your evidence, improve your CV, practise for the interview, and track the outcome.

Syncareer is free to use. There are no paid plans, tiers, or subscriptions, and no product feature is gated by payment.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview, product story, FAQs, and sign-up.
- [Career assessment](/assessment): A public 45-question RIASEC interest assessment; results are shown without an account.
- [Terms and Conditions](/terms): Rules governing access to and use of Syncareer.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Syncareer collects, uses and handles information.

## Notes

- Authenticated surfaces (dashboard, opportunities, applications, CV builder, interview simulator, mentors, settings) require an account and are not indexed.
